centralViewerQuestion: Will officers discover the concealed fentanyl pills and handgun hidden in the vehicle, and what criminal consequences will the driver and passenger face?

hookSelection.whyItWins: Candidate_003 (354-362s) delivers immediate visceral suspense as the officer orders the passenger out and spots him reaching for his waistband, winning over candidate_001 (routine license check for window tint) by establishing an urgent curiosity gap without prematurely spoiling the fentanyl drop or the weapon.
